designStatus: Designer candidate; awaiting Architect/UX/Science and real-app review

semanticRoles.seriesPrimary: Observed primary series, not automatic health status
semanticRoles.comparison: Comparison series (source comparability evaluated by code)
semanticRoles.categorical4: Fourth categorical series when legend requires it
semanticRoles.categorical5: Fifth categorical series when legend requires it
semanticRoles.referenceBand: Only render when a matching sourced interval exists
semanticRoles.referenceLine: The sourced interval boundary; not an independent healthy threshold
semanticRoles.threshold: A separately documented decision/action threshold, not lab interval
semanticRoles.uncertainty: Qualifies uncertainty without claiming a numeric confidence
semanticRoles.unknown: Missingness or source-unknown state; never render at y=0 unless measured 0
semanticRoles.focus: Keyboard focus indicator with >=3:1 against surface
semanticRoles.selectionHalo: Secondary presentation of selection, never the only cue

usageRules: Everyday/Athlete and light/dark have independent evaluated color roles
Use labels plus line patterns for categories, uncertainty and statuses; never depend only on hue
All axes, paths, points, boundaries and numeric labels must come from canonical runtime data
A missing measurement is not zero; disconnected observations stay disconnected
Reference intervals and decision thresholds require matching evidence/context and separate labels
Band opacity is visual-only; use labelled boundaries for scientific interpretation
Do not force values onto an artificial healthy/abnormal color ramp
Avoid passing rendered chart data into static SVG asset files
This opt-in CSS is scoped to .app-shell[data-bloom-visual="premium"] .bv-scientific-chart and is not imported until Architect approval
